items.title: 2x2 Grid Product Invention Visualization (Patent/Marketing)
items.prompt: Input Variable: {argument name="input objects" default="[INSERT 1 or 2 OBJECTS]"} Instruction: Act as a Visionary Industrial Designer and Patent Clerk. Create a 2x2 Grid visualizing the invention of a new product based on the Input. Innovation Logic : Analyze Functions: Identify the primary utility of Input A and Input B. The Fusion: Combine them into a single, cohesive device that solves a specific (niche) problem. If 2 Inputs: Hybridize them (e.g., Mug + Grater = A self-cooling mug with a garnish shaver). If 1 Input: Evolve it (e.g., Toothbrush = A self-sanitizing, toothpaste-injecting smart wand). The Branding: Generate a catchy, corporate product name (e.g., "The Breeze-Grate™", "Solar-Brella Pro"). The Visual Structure (The 2x2 Grid): CRITICAL: The image must be split into 4 distinct quadrants with different visual styles. Panel 1 (Top Left): The Exploded Patent View Style: Black & White Technical Line Art. Thin distinct lines, no shading. Content: An isometric "Exploded View" of the device, showing the internal motor, battery, or mechanism separated from the shell. Detail: Add Numbered Leader Lines (10, 12, 14) pointing to specific parts. Panel 2 (Top Right): The Functional Diagram Style: Black & White Schematic with bold arrows. Content: A cross-section or "In-Use" drawing showing how how the device works. Use Action Arrows to show airflow, rotation, or liquid movement. Detail: Show the "Result" (e.g., cheese falling, water spraying). Panel 3 (Bottom Left): The Product Render Style: High-End Studio Photography. Color, Glossy, "Apple/Braun" Design Aesthetic. Content: The final physical product sitting on a white reflective surface. It should look sleek, using materials like White Ceramic, Brushed Aluminum, or Matte Plastic. Context: Include a small prop to show scale (e.g., a block of cheese, a coffee bean, a hand). Panel 4 (Bottom Right): The Marketing Pitch Style: Editorial Magazine Layout. White background, black text. Typography: Headline: Large, Bold Serif Text displaying the [Invention Name]. Body: A block of clean "Lorem Ipsum" or readable text describing the "Revolutionary Features." Bullets: A small list of specs (e.g., "Dishwasher Safe," "USB-C"). Visual Syntax: Cohesion: The product design in Panel 3 must perfectly match the line art in Panel 1. Design Language: Minimalist, Ergonomic, Consumer Electronics aesthetic. Even if the idea is silly, the design must look expensive. Output: 2x2 Grid, Mixed Media (Line Art vs. Photorealism), 8k Resolution, "Kickstarter Campaign" Aesthetic.

items.title: Dark Luxury Fallen Angel Editorial
items.prompt: Ultra-photorealistic 2x2 luxury glossy editorial collage featuring the same woman across all four panels, with strict identity consistency, strict body consistency, the same skin tone, the same proportions, and the same elegant posture language in every frame. CONCEPT: A dark luxury fashion editorial centered on sculptural back lines, shoulders, neck, arms, and an open-back deep red dress, with a mysterious fallen-angel aura. The mood is sensual, elegant, expensive, cinematic, controlled, and minimal. The overall feeling should be high-fashion editorial, refined and dramatic, never cheap or costume-like. SUBJECT: A beautiful woman with long loose black hair, consistent identity across all four panels. Hair is sleek yet softly textured, flowing naturally down the back and shoulders. Makeup is dark smoky eye makeup with softly diffused black shadow, defined brows, and a polished editorial finish. Nails are glossy deep red or black-cherry, long and elegant. Expression and body language are poised, feminine, and powerful. OUTFIT: Deep crimson / burgundy / blood-red velvet or satin halter dress with an open back, realistic glossy fabric highlights, natural draping, subtle tension around the waist and hips, and elegant luxury construction. The dress must look premium and believable, with no fabric glitches. The red should feel rich, dark, and sophisticated, not bright or cheap. WINGS: Large dark red angel wings behind the woman, dramatic and elegant, slightly torn and weathered for a fallen-angel feeling. The wings should feel sculptural and luxurious, not fantasy cosplay. Feather texture should be rich, layered, deep burgundy to oxblood red, with softly darkened damaged edges. The wings must integrate beautifully with the poses and lighting without overpowering the fashion editorial tone. SKIN: Glossy editorial wet-skin finish with a subtle oil sheen on the shoulders, upper back, neck, arms, and along the spine line. Real skin texture must remain visible, including pores, natural tonal variation, and realistic highlights. No plastic smoothing. The sheen should look expensive, controlled, and believable, not sweaty or messy. ENVIRONMENT: Minimal studio background with a warm grey, taupe, or soft beige seamless backdrop. No props, no distractions, no clutter. LIGHTING: Premium glossy studio lighting: - large softbox key light from the upper side - narrow rim light tracing the shoulders, spine, and wing edges - soft warm highlights on skin and fabric - deep but clean shadows - smooth gradient falloff - high-end editorial contrast - no harsh flash - no fake glow GRID 2x2: TOP LEFT: Back-facing pose, arms raised above the head, hands resting in the hair. Spine line, shoulder blades, and upper wing structure are emphasized with glossy highlights. Black hair falls naturally over part of the back while the open-back red dress and wings remain clearly visible. TOP RIGHT: Slight torso twist, one shoulder closer to the camera, head turned subtly away. The red dress catches light along one side, and the dark red angel wings frame the silhouette elegantly. Strong emphasis on shoulder, waist, and back contour. BOTTOM LEFT: Closer crop on the upper back, neck, shoulders, hands, and partial wing texture. Focus on wet-skin texture, glossy nails, smoky makeup details near the eye area if visible, and luxury detail in the red dress fabric. BOTTOM RIGHT: Elegant half-turn pose from behind, body rotated slightly, side profile subtly hinted but face mostly hidden. Strong glossy rim light on the shoulder, waist curve, and the edge of the dark red wings. The silhouette should feel sleek, mysterious, and powerful. CAMERA: Medium format fashion photography look, 85mm or 100mm lens, f/2.0, ISO 100, shallow depth of field, ultra-sharp focus on skin texture, hair texture, feather detail, and fabric finish, ultra high resolution, luxury editorial quality. COLOR GRADE: Deep burgundy, oxblood, crimson, and soft warm neutrals, with subtle champagne skin highlights and elegant shadow contrast. Fine film grain. Rich dark editorial tonality. No oversaturation. REALISM RULES: Anatomically correct back, shoulders, arms, hands, neck, and spine curve. Realistic skin sheen. Realistic red dress tension and drape. Realistic feather texture and wing anatomy. No exaggerated body proportions. No fantasy illustration look. Keep everything photorealistic and luxury editorial. NEGATIVE PROMPT: plastic skin, over-smoothed skin, fake oil, fake glow, sweaty messy look, harsh flash, distorted spine, bad anatomy, extra fingers, warped hands, broken shoulders, unrealistic wings, cheap costume wings, fake feathers, fabric glitches, unrealistic dress, altered body proportions, cartoon, anime, illustration, text, watermark, logo, oversharpening, AI artifacts
